subject: general
question: If (x - {1 over x}) = 10, what is the value of (x⁴ - {1 over x⁴})?
solution:
**Given:-**

x - 1/x = 10

**Formula used:- **

A² -B² = (A + B) (A - B)

 

(A + B)² = A² + B² + 2AB

**Calculation:- **

⇒ x - 1/x = 10 .....(1)

Square both sides

⇒ (x -1/x)² = 10² 

⇒ x² + 1/x² - 2 = 100 

⇒ x2 + 1/x2 = 102 .....(2)

Add 2 both sides

⇒ x2 + 1/x2 + 2 = 102 + 2 

⇒ (x + 1/x )² = 104 

⇒ (x + 1/x ) = √ 104 .....(3)

As per the question, 

⇒ x⁴ - 1/x⁴

⇒(x² - 1/x²)(x² + 1/x²) 

⇒ (x + 1/x) (x -1/x) (x2 + 1/x2)

Put the value of (x -1/x), (x -1/x) (x2 + 1/x2) from equation(1,2&3) 

⇒ 10 × √104 × 102 = 1020√104 

**∴ The required answer is __1020____√104__.**
